# ===== Colony fleets (slices 2-3 design §§ 4-7) =====
# A colony's goal at each stage (the races-only bar reads the current stage's
# through sr_solar_colonization_goal, space_race_values.txt).
sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 = { value = 400 }
sr_colonization_goal_stage_2 = { value = 450 }
sr_colonization_goal_stage_3 = { value = 500 }
sr_colonization_goal_stage_4 = { value = 550 }
sr_colonization_goal_stage_5 = { value = 650 }
sr_cf_horizon_months = { value = 180 }
sr_cf_no_score = { value = -1000 }

# Per world, country scope:
#   sr_cf_goal_<key>     its colony's goal: its own stage's under simple and full, the
#                        current stage's under races only (a released world costs that)
#   sr_cf_cost_<key>     what a fleet leaving now spends: goal x (1 + premium);
#                        sr_launch_never's x goal when it can't leave
#   sr_cf_arrival_<key>  the month a fleet leaving now lands, by THIS's drive
#   sr_cf_score_<key>    the automatic pick: 100 - 10 x stage - transit / 2 - 40 x premium
#                        - 10 a fleet inbound - 60 if one lands first
sr_cf_goal_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1
	if = { limit = { NOT = { sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes } } value = sr_solar_colonization_goal }
}
sr_cf_cost_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_launch_target_cost_mars
	add = 1
	multiply = sr_cf_goal_valles_marineris
}
sr_cf_arrival_valles_marineris = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	add = sr_transit_months_mars
}
sr_cf_score_valles_marineris = {
	value = 90
	subtract = { value = sr_transit_months_mars divide = 2 }
	subtract = { value = sr_launch_target_cost_mars multiply = 40 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_valles_marineris } subtract = { value = global_var:sr_site_inbound_valles_marineris multiply = 10 } }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_beaten_valles_marineris = yes } subtract = 60 }
	min = -900
}

	if = { limit = { NOT = { sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes } } value = sr_solar_colonization_goal }
}
sr_cf_cost_mercury = { value = sr_cf_goal_mercury }
sr_cf_arrival_mercury = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	add = sr_transit_months_mercury
}
sr_cf_score_mercury = {
	value = 70
	subtract = { value = sr_transit_months_mercury divide = 2 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_mercury } subtract = { value = global_var:sr_site_inbound_mercury multiply = 10 } }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_beaten_mercury = yes } subtract = 60 }
	min = -900
}

# The best score among the eligible worlds; sr_cf_no_score when none is.
sr_cf_best_score = {
	value = sr_cf_no_score
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_valles_marineris = yes } min = sr_cf_score_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_olympus_mons = yes } min = sr_cf_score_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_hellas_planitia = yes } min = sr_cf_score_hellas_planitia }

# The target's goal (sr_solar_colonization_goal under simple and full).
sr_cf_target_goal = {
	value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 1 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 2 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 3 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 4 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 5 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 6 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 7 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 }

# ===== Population (slices 2-3 design § 10) =====
sr_site_crew_per_level = { value = 5000 }

# Per world, any scope: its room (people, before modules), its people, its free
# room, and the module levels above the first its people can crew. Country scope:
# THIS's priority weight for it (Closed 0, Low 1, Normal 2, High 4; Normal when
# unset) and its emigration weight, priority x free room, 0 unless THIS holds it.
sr_site_room_valles_marineris = { value = 50000 }
sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_valles_marineris } value = global_var:sr_site_pop_valles_marineris }
}
sr_site_free_room_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_room_valles_marineris
	subtract = sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris
	min = 0
}

# Country scope: the sum of THIS's emigration weights; the free room of the
# colonies it holds that are open to settlers; its people off Earth.
sr_emig_weight_total = {
	value = 0
	add = sr_emig_weight_valles_marineris
	add = sr_emig_weight_olympus_mons
	add = sr_emig_weight_hellas_planitia
	add = sr_emig_weight_utopia_planitia
	add = sr_emig_weight_arcadia_planitia
	add = sr_emig_weight_ceres

	add = sr_emig_weight_pallas
	add = sr_emig_weight_hygiea
	add = sr_emig_weight_io
	add = sr_emig_weight_europa
	add = sr_emig_weight_ganymede
	add = sr_emig_weight_callisto
	add = sr_emig_weight_himalia
	add = sr_emig_weight_amalthea
	add = sr_emig_weight_venus
	add = sr_emig_weight_mercury
	add = sr_emig_weight_titan
	add = sr_emig_weight_enceladus
	add = sr_emig_weight_rhea
	add = sr_emig_weight_mimas
	add = sr_emig_weight_iapetus
